name: SafaView – AI Halal Content Filter for Safer Browsing
description: AI-powered media filtering that analyzes images and automatically blocks or allows content based on customizable safety rules.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://* http://* http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; child-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://* http://* http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*
